7:30pm for an evening of disco, games, fun and treats. prize for the best costume.th halloween movie & fun: join klaws tech amergin, waterville on saturday 31 october at 2pm for a family-friendly halloween event. film is flow, a reading from howl at halloween, facepainting, puzzles, colouring. cost €5 per person. all ages welcome. st join aidan byrne and fr sean jones for a special two-day retreat at the oratory of divine mercy in waterville on friday, 30th october, and saturday, 31st october . this retreat will offer a beautiful opportunity to deepen our faith , reflect on the communion of saints, and discover how we can help our dearly departed through prayer, the holy mass, and acts of devotion. friday, 30th october – beginning at 7:30pm the evening will begin with the rosary, followed by mass for the holy souls, a talk on all hallows eve, and concluding prayers for healing. saturday, 31st october – beginning at 9:30am. the day will include the rosary and talks on:‘our friends, the holy souls’ / ‘praying for the holy souls’ ‘blockag es to prayer’ ‘how the holy souls help their benefactors’ the retreat will culminate in mass for the holy souls at 3:00pm, fo llowed by healing prayers. all are warmly welcome to attend this special time o f prayer, reflection, and spiritual renewal. no charge but donations are welco me on the day. bring a packed lunch.⛳ congratulations to all ‘birdies for buddy’ a sincere word of congratulations and appreciation to everyone involved in the recent ‘birdies for buddy’ fundrais er, held at waterville golf links on saturday last. the day was truly blessed with beautiful sunshine, making it a wonderful occa sion filled with goodwill, generosity and community spirit. it was hea rtening to see so many people come together in support of this very worthy cause, raising funds for buddy and his pals at st francis special school in beaufort. a special word of thanks and appreciation to michael, miriam and all the team at waterville golf links for their generosity in making this wonderful event possible. their cont inued support for our community, and their kindness towards those in n eed, is greatly appreciated and is a wonderful example of the diffe rence we can make when we come together for others. to everyone who organised, participated in, sponsor ed and supported the fundraiser in any way, thank you. your generosity will make a real difference to buddy and his friends, and your support is a testament to the kindness and compassion that exists within our community. mass of remembrance for our deceased 25/26 friday 13th november: st finian’s 7.30pm one of the most cherished moments in our parish calendar is annual mass of remembrance for those who have died during the past year. we will gather in prayer for all our parishioners and loved ones who haved ied during 2025 and 2026, remembering their lives, giving thanks for the gifts they shared with us, and entrusting them to the loving mercy of god. this mass will be an opportunity for families and friends to come together in faith, to find comfort in the eucharist, and to remember those whose absence is still deeply felt. please contact the parish office to include names of those who died outside of the parish that you would like included in our mass. in november we remember as we welcome the month of november, the church invites us to turn our hearts in a special way towards the holy souls and to remember with love and gratitude all those who have gone before us marked with the sign of faith. november is a month of quiet reflection, heartfelt prayer and christian hope. we remember our parents, grandparents, relatives, friends, parishioners and all those whose lives have touched our own. though they are no longer with us in this earthly life, the bonds of love remain , and we continue to entrust them to the mercy and goodness of god. the church reminds us that death does not have the final word. through the death and resurrection of jesus christ, we are given the promise of etern al life. as we pray for the faithful departed, we are united with them in the communion o f saints, trusting that god's love is greater than death itself. “eternal rest grant unto them, o lord, and let perpetu al light shine upon them. may they rest in peace. amen.” the holy souls preparing for 30 days helping our dearly departed retreat at the oratory of divine mercy november lists of the dead during november, holy masses and prayers will be offered for all those remembered on our november lists of the dead, as we commend our departed loved ones to the loving mercy of god. parishioners are invited to place their lists in the offertory during mass or return them to the parish office throughout the month. we are deeply grateful for your prayerful remembrance and offering. date for the diary blessing of the oratory of the divine mercy friday 6 november 11:00am th by bishop ray browne - bishop of & intentions week beginning 24th october 2026 day church time intention saturday derrinagree 7.30pm denis & mary o’riordan, keale denis o’sullivan, dysert catherine & nicholas tarrant, clenrath and their daughter marie, their grandson daniel o’connell and george tarrant, moher con o’connor, rathroe and the deceased members of the o’connor family sunday dromagh 10.00am timmy mcseeeney, rathcoole donie mcsweeney, ardrahan pat holland, dundalk weekend 31st oct/1st nov 2026 saturday derrinagree 7.30pm sunday dromagh 10.00am john o’sullivan, dromagh and his parents patrick & nora and his brothers and sisters the 10am mass on sunday 22nd november in dromagh church will be offered for all who have died in our parish since last november. we have all their names, but we would also like to remember at this mass, relatives of parishioners who have died outside the parish. names of your relatives to be handed in to the parish office before the 18th of november so that they will be prayerfully called out during the mass. the parish office will be open on wednesday from 9am – 12pm instead of 1 – 4pm this week. ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, t alks, and a healing service. speakers include: fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon per eira op, nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, christine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on

torc community and family resource centre is delighted to welcome john lonergan to teach íosagáin, rathmore, on 4th november 8pm, for an engaging and thought- provoking talk on “parenting in a modern society.” john is a highly respected speaker who served as governor of mountjoy prison for over 22 years and gover nor of portlaoise prison for almost four years. following his retirement in 2010, he published his autobiog raphy, the governor, and later wrote parenting – raising your child in ireland today. drawing on his extensive experience and insights, john will explore the challenges and realities of parenting in today’s society. everyone welcome. st. vincent de paul if you or anyone you know needs our assistance or would like to donate, please contact
